content.text: {"id": "mm5440a6", "data_focus": {"v": "limited", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "received five reports of Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) in persons after receipt of MCV4 vaccination"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "No cases of GBS have been detected among nearly 110,000 MCV4 recipients"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "These cases were reported from Pennsylvania (two), New York, Ohio, and New Jersey (one case each)."}]}, {"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Data from two VSD sites indicated that 86%--97% of vaccine recipients had 6 weeks of follow-up"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "All five persons had been vaccinated during June 10--July 25."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "is similar to what might have been expected to occur by chance alone."}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "case report/series", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "This report describes the clinical and epidemiologic features of these five cases"}]}, {"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "VAERS, operated by CDC and the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), is a national passive surveillance system"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC has conducted a rapid survey by using available VSD and other health-care--organization databases."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Data from two VSD sites indicated that 86%--97% of vaccine recipients had 6 weeks of follow-up via automated data collection."}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["data_focus", "analytic_depth"]}
